# graviteeam_admin_metadata (Data Source)

Reads Gravitee AM administrative metadata such as organization audits, environments, domain HRID lookups, and user audits

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_admin_metadata" "organization_audits" {
  kind = "organization_audits"
  size = 10
}

data "graviteeam_admin_metadata" "organization_environments" {
  kind = "organization_environments"
}

data "graviteeam_admin_metadata" "domain_by_hrid" {
  kind = "domain_by_hrid"
  hrid = graviteeam_domain.example.name
}

data "graviteeam_admin_metadata" "user_audits" {
  kind      = "user_audits"
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  user_id   = graviteeam_user.example.id
  size      = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Administrative metadata kind. Supported values: domain_by_hrid, organization_audits, organization_environments, user_audits

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Domain ID, required for user_audits
- `hrid` (String) Domain human-readable ID, required for domain_by_hrid
- `size` (Number) Maximum audit entries to retrieve for audit kinds (default: 10)
- `user_id` (String) User ID, required for user_audits

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the administrative metadata response
